lines.japanese: 「今ごろ小鳩はひとりで荷物を持って大変だろうなあ。買いすぎてないといいね」
lines.english: “Kobato must be struggling with all those bags by herself right now. I hope she didn't buy too much.”

lines.japanese: 渡来さんのマンションへ向かう道中、僕の気分は晴れ晴れしかった。
lines.english: My spirits were bright as we walked toward Watarai's apartment.

lines.japanese: 「うちの妹って、出来過ぎかもしれないなあ」
lines.english: “My sister may be too perfect.”

lines.japanese: 「うん、本当いい子だね」
lines.english: “Yeah. She's a really good kid.”

lines.japanese: 「でも羽田君、それ言うの五回目だね」
lines.english: “But Haneda, that's the fifth time you've said that.”

lines.japanese: 「そうだっけ？」
lines.english: “Is it?”

lines.japanese: 「羽田君ってけっこー兄馬鹿だったんだ」
lines.english: “I never knew you were such a doting brother.”

lines.japanese: 「え？　そんなことはないと思うけど」
lines.english: “What? I don't think I am.”

lines.japanese: 「そう、だって、この前ネットで見たんだけどね、男が女を守りたいと思うのは生物としての本能に近いらしいよ」
lines.english: “Oh. Because I read online the other day that when a man wants to protect a woman, it's almost a biological instinct.”

lines.japanese: 「あそー」
lines.english: “Oh, yeah?”

lines.japanese: 返事は適当だった。
lines.english: Her answer was halfhearted.

lines.japanese: もしかしたら兄馬鹿というのは、彼女の理想の男性像から離れているのだろうか。もっとも僕は兄馬鹿ではないのだけれど。
lines.english: Perhaps being a doting brother put me farther from her ideal man. Not that I was a doting brother.

lines.japanese: 羽田鷹志が気にかけるのは、妹に限った話じゃないってことを証明したい。
lines.english: I wanted to prove that a sister wasn't the only person Takashi Haneda cared for.

lines.japanese: 「そうだ、渡来さんはなにか困ってることない？　なんでも手伝うよ」
lines.english: “Oh, right. Is there anything troubling you, Watarai? I'll help with anything.”

lines.japanese: 「いま？　いや、とくにないけど」
lines.english: “Right now? No, not especially.”

lines.japanese: それは困る。渡来さんの前で男を上げろというのは、妹から与えられた僕の使命だ。
lines.english: That was a problem. My sister had given me a mission: raise my man points in front of Watarai.

lines.japanese: 進路の先に見えてきた、渡来さんのマンションを見上げて問う。
lines.english: Her apartment building came into view ahead, and I looked up at it as I asked:

lines.japanese: 「日曜大工とか、部屋の模様替えとか、ない？　女の子のひとり暮らしだと、そういうの大変でしょ」
lines.english: “Any home repairs? Want to rearrange your room? Living alone as a girl must make things like that difficult.”

lines.japanese: 「私、そういうのは、気付いたときにやっちゃうからなあ」
lines.english: “I tend to take care of that stuff as soon as I notice it.”

lines.japanese: 「あ、そうだ、あれは？」
lines.english: “Oh, what about that?”

lines.japanese: ふと、教室で高内さんを交えて話した、数日前の記憶がよみがえった。
lines.english: I suddenly remembered a conversation from a few days earlier in the classroom with Takauchi.

lines.japanese: 「ほら、たしかＤＶＤレコーダー買ったまま放置してたよね」
lines.english: “You bought a DVD recorder and left it sitting around, didn't you?”

lines.japanese: 「あー、忘れてた。私、機械類の扱いホント弱いから。とくにああいう男家電は」
lines.english: “Oh, I forgot. I'm terrible with machines. Especially that sort of masculine appliance.”

lines.japanese: オーディオ器機のことだろう。さしづめ女家電は、洗濯機や冷蔵庫といった白物系か。
lines.english: She presumably meant audio and video equipment. Feminine appliances, then, must be household appliances such as washing machines and refrigerators.

lines.japanese: 「まかせて。僕なら出来るから」
lines.english: “Leave it to me. I can do it.”

lines.japanese: まさしく男を上げる絶好の機会だ。たぶんコードの端子を差しこむだけだと思うけど。
lines.english: This was the perfect opportunity to raise my man points. I expected it would only involve plugging in a few cables.

lines.japanese: 「ええ？　べつにいいよ、そんな取り急ぎ必要なモンでもないし──」
lines.english: “What? You don't have to. It's not like I urgently need the thing—”

lines.japanese: 「──あ、うそ。やっぱりお願いする。部屋へ連れこむ理由になるから」
lines.english: “—actually, never mind. Please do. It'll give me a reason to bring you into my room.”

lines.japanese: 「理由って。なに言ってるのいまさら、普通に誘ってくれればいいじゃない」
lines.english: “A reason? What are you talking about at this point? You could simply invite me.”

lines.japanese: 「んー、あんまり女からばっかってのも、はしたないかなーって」
lines.english: “Hmm. It feels a little shameless if the woman always does the inviting.”

lines.japanese: 「てゆーわけで、うちのなんとかレコーダーを取りつけに来てください」
lines.english: “So please come over and install my whatever-recorder.”

lines.japanese: おどけた風に言って腕を絡める、僕の恋人。
lines.english: My girlfriend said it playfully and linked her arm through mine.

lines.japanese: 彼女の助けになれる。それはとても光栄なことだ。
lines.english: I could be of help to her. That was a tremendous honor.

lines.japanese: 僕はいつだって誰かの力になりたいと思っているけれど、それが大好きなひとのことであれば何よりも嬉しい。
lines.english: I always wanted to help someone, but nothing could make me happier than helping the person I loved.

lines.japanese: 「わあい、羽田君は兄馬鹿だけど彼女にも優しいなあ」
lines.english: “Hooray. Haneda's a doting brother, but he's nice to his girlfriend too.”

lines.japanese: 「えっ？　いや、べつに兄馬鹿ってほどじゃないよ。うん、まあ、普通かな」
lines.english: “What? No, I'm not that doting. I'd say I'm about average.”

lines.japanese: じゃあ、すぐにセットしてしまおう。
lines.english: All right. I would set it up immediately.

lines.japanese: 作業時間の長短と、上昇するオトコ度は反比例するんじゃないかと思う。
lines.english: I had a feeling the time a job took was inversely proportional to how many man points it earned.

lines.japanese: 渡来さんがお茶の準備をしている間に、箱からレコーダー本体や付属品を取りだした。
lines.english: While Watarai prepared tea, I unpacked the recorder and its accessories.

lines.japanese: 大手メーカーの品だし、シンプルな接続方法だろうから、マニュアルは読まなくても問題なさそうだった。
lines.english: It came from a major manufacturer, and the connection should be simple. I saw no need to read the manual.

lines.japanese: 「あれ、もう始めてるの？」
lines.english: “Oh, you already started?”

lines.japanese: 渡来さんは軽めのお菓子とアップルソーダを運んできた。
lines.english: Watarai brought over a light snack and apple soda.

lines.japanese: 「どうせすぐ終わるだろうから、パパッとやっちゃおうと思って」
lines.english: “It should be over in a minute, so I thought I'd knock it out right away.”

lines.japanese: 「そんな急ぐことないのに。まー、とりあえずこっち来て座りなよ」
lines.english: “You don't have to rush. Come over here and sit down for now.”

lines.japanese: 「ううん、ほんとすぐ終わるから。得意なんだよ、こういうの」
lines.english: “No, really. I'll be done in a minute. I'm good at this kind of thing.”

lines.japanese: 「そう？　ふーん……あ、ジュースどうする？」
lines.english: “Are you? Hmm... What about your drink?”

lines.japanese: 「ありがとう。すぐ終わるから、そこ置いといてもらえれば」
lines.english: “Thanks. I'll be done in a minute, so just leave it there.”

lines.japanese: 「うん」
lines.english: “Okay.”

lines.japanese: よし、がんばって男を上げるぞ。
lines.english: All right. Time to work hard and raise my man points.

lines.japanese: 僕はいつだって渡来さんの力になりたいと思っているんだ。
lines.english: I always wanted to be of help to Watarai.

lines.japanese: 「おかしいな……普通にやってるのに、なんで映らないんだろ……」
lines.english: “That's strange... I connected everything normally, so why isn't there a picture...?”

lines.japanese: 「はぁー、林檎ソーダ美味しいなあ」
lines.english: “Aah. Apple soda is delicious.”

lines.japanese: 「うーん……仕方ない、マニュアルに目を通すか……」
lines.english: “Hmm... No choice. I'll take a look at the manual...”

lines.japanese: 「ふぅー、やっぱり自宅デートはいろいろ気を使わなくて楽だね。いやいや、こういうのいいね」
lines.english: “Phew. Dates at home really are easy. You don't have to worry about anything. This is nice.”

lines.japanese: 「え？　ああ、そうだね。そんなことより渡来さん」
lines.english: “Hm? Oh, yes. It is. More importantly, Watarai...”

lines.japanese: 「ん、なになに？」
lines.english: “Hm? What is it?”

lines.japanese: 「これ、ハードディスクの容量３２０ギガしかないから、長く保存したいものは小まめにＤＶＤへ移してった方がいいかも。空のディスクは持ってる？」
lines.english: “The hard drive is only 320 gigabytes. If there's anything you want to keep for a long time, you should transfer it to DVD regularly. Do you have any blank discs?”

lines.japanese: 「えー、よく分かんないけど、ＤＶＤに空とか空じゃないとかあるの」
lines.english: “I don't really understand. DVDs can be blank or not blank?”

lines.japanese: 「あるよ、録画とかできるやつ。いまから買いに行く？」
lines.english: “Yes. The kind you can record onto. Want to go buy some now?”

lines.japanese: 「いやいやいや、また今度でいいよ。今日はさ、ほら、もう疲れちゃったでしょ。とりあえず休めば？」
lines.english: “No, no, no. Another day is fine. You've got to be tired by now. Why don't you rest for a while?”

lines.japanese: 「ありがとう、大丈夫だよ。ほんと得意だから、こういうの」
lines.english: “Thank you, but I'm fine. I'm really good at this kind of thing.”

lines.japanese: このぐらい出来なくては、渡来さんに頼りない男だと思われてしまう。
lines.english: If I couldn't even do this much, Watarai might think I was unreliable.

lines.japanese: 何の取り柄もない僕だけど、せめて彼女を喜ばせる努力だけは惜しみたくないんだ。
lines.english: I had no particular virtues, but at the very least, I never wanted to spare any effort that might make her happy.

lines.japanese: 「羽田君、スウェット持ってきたよ。泊ってくでしょ」
lines.english: “Haneda, I brought you some sweats. You're staying over, right?”

lines.japanese: 「うーん……どういうことなんだ？　おかしいな、マニュアル通りなら……」
lines.english: “Hmm... What could be wrong? That's strange. If I followed the manual...”

lines.japanese: 「羽田君！」
lines.english: “Haneda!”
“Huh...? Oh. What?”

lines.japanese: 「着替え」
lines.english: “Clothes.”

lines.japanese: 「ああ、着替えるの？　うん、いいよ。渡来さんの家なんだもん、楽な格好になりなよ」
lines.english: “Oh, you're changing? Of course. This is your home, Watarai. Make yourself comfortable.”

lines.japanese: 「私じゃなくて、羽田君の。ハイ、ここ置いとくからね」
lines.english: “Not me. You. I'll leave them here.”

lines.japanese: 「ありがとう、これ終わったら着替えるよ。もうすぐ終わりそうだから」
lines.english: “Thanks. I'll change when I'm finished. It should be almost done.”

lines.japanese: 「ねえ、なんだったらソレ、またべつの日でもいいよ？　とりあえずお茶でもして落ちつこうよ」
lines.english: “Listen, we can leave that thing for another day if you want. Why don't we have some tea and relax for now?”

lines.japanese: 「でも、ホントあとちょっとで終わると思うから」
lines.english: “But I really think I'm almost finished.”

lines.japanese: 「そーお？」
lines.english: “Is that so?”

lines.japanese: 「得意なんだ、こういうの」
lines.english: “I'm good at this kind of thing.”

lines.japanese: 「じゃー、ちょっと待つ」
lines.english: “Okaaay. I'll wait a little.”
“Phew...”

lines.japanese: 「てりゃ」
lines.english: “Hiyah.”

lines.japanese: 「ひゃ！」
lines.english: “Eek!”

lines.japanese: 考え事をしていたら、とつぜん渡来さんに脇を突付かれた。思わず体がくの字になった。
lines.english: I was lost in thought when Watarai suddenly poked me in the side. My body folded at the waist.

lines.japanese: 「い、いきなり何」
lines.english: “Wh-why would you do that out of nowhere?”

lines.japanese: 「うん、真面目にやってるから、ちょっかいかけてみたくて」
lines.english: “You were working so seriously that I wanted to bother you.”

lines.japanese: 「ひどいなあ。もう少しで終わるから、ふざけないで待ってて」
lines.english: “That's mean. I'm almost done, so stop fooling around and wait.”

lines.japanese: 「はーい」
lines.english: “Okaaay.”

lines.japanese: 僕がここへ来て、まだ二時間ぐらいしか経っていないけれど、渡来さんは退屈なんだろうか。
lines.english: I had only been here for about two hours, but was Watarai already bored?

lines.japanese: 彼女のためにも早く作業を終わらせてしま──
lines.english: For her sake too, I needed to finish quickly—

lines.japanese: 「うりゃっ」
lines.english: “Hrah!”

lines.japanese: 「ひゃああ！」
lines.english: “Hyaaaah!”

lines.japanese: 五秒もしないうちから、またしても脇を突かれた。僕はくの字を通りこしてＣの字になった。
lines.english: Not five seconds later, she poked my side again. I folded past an angle and into the shape of a C.

lines.japanese: 「もう、やめてよ渡来さん。ほんとにもうちょっとだから」
lines.english: “Come on, stop, Watarai. I'm honestly almost done.”

lines.japanese: 「ごめんね、悪気はなかったんだよ」
lines.english: “Sorry. I didn't mean any harm.”

lines.japanese: 「ううん、いまのに悪気がないっていうのは、図々しいにも程があるよ」
lines.english: “No. Claiming you meant no harm after that is shameless beyond belief.”

lines.japanese: 「羽田くーん、なんか暑くない？」
lines.english: “Hanedaaa, isn't it kind of hot in here?”

lines.japanese: 「そう？　エアコン下げてもらって大丈夫だよ」
lines.english: “Is it? You can turn down the air conditioner.”

lines.japanese: 「ふぅー、ちょっと脱いじゃおっかなー。脱いじゃおーっと」
lines.english: “Phew. Maybe I'll take something off. Yes, let's take something off.”

lines.japanese: 「あ、僕だったら気にしないで。渡来さんが全裸でうろうろしてても、いまさら驚かないし」
lines.english: “Don't mind me. You could walk around completely naked at this point and I wouldn't be surprised.”

lines.japanese: 「なんだと」
lines.english: “What did you say?”

lines.japanese: 「ねえ渡来さん、そんなことより、リモコン用のボタン電池ないかな」
lines.english: “More importantly, Watarai, do you have a coin battery for the remote?”

lines.japanese: 「ここ」
lines.english: “Right here.”

lines.japanese: 「ひゃっ」
lines.english: “Eek!”

lines.japanese: 渡来さんに胸の先端を突かれた。
lines.english: Watarai poked the tip of my nipple.

lines.japanese: 「もう、やめなよ、そういう品のない冗談──」
lines.english: “Come on. Stop making vulgar jokes like that—”

lines.japanese: 「へへー」
lines.english: “Hehehe.”

lines.japanese: 「えっ……わ、うわっ」
lines.english: “Huh...? Wh-whoa.”

lines.japanese: 渡来さんはやめるどころか、僕の背中に圧しかかってきた。首のまわりに腕が巻きついて、ブラウス越しの胸が押しつけられる。
lines.english: Far from stopping, Watarai pressed herself against my back. Her arms wrapped around my neck, and her breasts pushed against me through her blouse.

lines.japanese: 「ねー、まずはいちゃいちゃしようってー」
lines.english: “Come on. Let's fool around first.”

lines.japanese: 「駄目だよ渡来さん、やるって決めたことは先に終わらせないと」
lines.english: “We can't, Watarai. Once you decide to do something, you have to finish it first.”

lines.japanese: 流されそうな誘惑に抗って、僕は作業続行を主張した。
lines.english: Resisting the temptation to let myself be swept along, I insisted on continuing the work.

lines.japanese: 「あんま彼女ほったらかしてると男が下がるよー？」
lines.english: “Ignore your girlfriend too long and your man points will go down.”

lines.japanese: 「え、それは困るけど」
lines.english: “What? That would be a problem.”

lines.japanese: 「困れ困れー。はー、困ってる羽田君にくっついてるだけで、いちゃるぎーが補給されていくなあ」
lines.english: “Good. Be troubled. Ahh, just clinging to troubled Haneda is filling up my flirt-energy.”

lines.japanese: 渡来さんの手が、僕の服の中に忍びこんできた。腹から胸を愛おしげに撫でさすってゆく。
lines.english: Watarai's hand slipped inside my clothes. She lovingly stroked from my stomach up across my chest.

lines.japanese: やがては下腹部へ侵入してきた。
lines.english: Before long, it invaded my lower abdomen.

lines.japanese: 「ちょっ……渡来さん、何してるの」
lines.english: “W-wait... Watarai, what are you doing?”

lines.japanese: 「羽田君を惑わせてその気にさせよう計画」
lines.english: “Executing my plan to bewilder Haneda and get him in the mood.”

lines.japanese: 片手で僕の上半身を愛撫しながら、残る手でベルトに手をかける。
lines.english: One hand caressed my upper body while the other reached for my belt.

lines.japanese: 「女を上げてやるぜ」
lines.english: “Time to raise my woman points.”
